message.be-careful.nether_warning.2: You cannot withstand the heat much longer...
message.be-careful.nether_warning.3: The air is beginning to burn...
message.be-careful.deep_dark_entry.1: A chill goes down your spine...
message.be-careful.deep_dark_entry.3: You feel a corrupting energy building...
message.be-careful.deep_dark_warning.2: You feel smothered in the darkness...
message.be-careful.not_ruined_portal.1: The dimensional connection is not strong enough here...
message.be-careful.not_ruined_portal.2: There is no anchor between worlds here...
message.be-careful.not_ruined_portal.3: A dimensional bridge is not able to manifest here...
message.be-careful.no_overworld_anchor.2: This gateway does not lead anywhere...
message.be-careful.no_overworld_anchor.3: No dimensional connection can be made here...
message.be-careful.totem_cleanse.1: The light purges the encroaching darkness...
message.be-careful.totem_cleanse.2: A cleansing light is bestowed upon you...
message.be-careful.totem_cleanse.3: The totem cleanses you of the crushing darkness...
message.be-careful.chunk_tamed.2: The wilderness is calmer in this area...
message.be-careful.bed_unsafe.1: This land is too wild to rest in.
message.be-careful.bed_unsafe.2: The shadows of this untamed place keep you awake.
gamerule.chunkTameTime.description: The amount of time (in ticks) a player must inhabit a chunk before it is considered 'tamed' and safe for sleep.
gamerule.onlyRuinedPortals.description: If enabled, Nether portals can only be activated if they are part of a Ruined Portal structure or have a valid anchor.
